scope_and_limitations: Reviewed frozen title and complete ItemBody for all 160 assigned items; every 254 assigned PNG tile was opened separately at original resolution.
Local frozen snapshots, HTML and screenshots only; no HTTP or live website review.
Wikilinks intentionally render on separate block lines. CSS uppercase technique banners are expected; no separate optional typography issue recorded.
Capture tiles may crop at their viewport boundary; no clipping defect is asserted absent evidence from the individual standalone tile.
No production route navigation, dependency graph or Sources footer review.
